entry.title: Hyprland 0.53.0 for Fedora
entry.summary:
Hyprland team bumped the version on December 29th. I didn't wait and updated my COPR repo. After a day of driving, I can confirm: life in 2026 hasn't gotten worse — quite the opposite :) The repo has 150 users at the time of posting. If you're among them: # Refresh metadata sudo dnf copr enable ashbuk/Hyprland-Fedora --refresh
# Upgrade sudo dnf upgrade hyprland
See my previous post for details. Note: this COPR intentionally does not include optional Qt-based GUI helpers (welcome screens, crash dialogs, donation prompts). Hyprland works perfectly without them. This aligns with my packaging approach: no extra functionality by default — anything missing can be added consciously.
Package Description
hyprland Dynamic tiling Wayland compositor (includes Hyprland, hyprctl, hyprpm, start-hyprland)
xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland Portal backend for screen sharing, file dialogs - separate spec
Hyprland includes a small set of upstream-vendored libraries (as shown on the image cover), $ORIGIN-based RUNPATH. No extra bundling beyond upstream defaults. If it looks good: # Enable the repo sudo dnf copr enable ashbuk/Hyprland-Fedora
# Install core compositor sudo dnf install hyprland
# Screen sharing support (recommended) sudo dnf install xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland
Heads up: 0.53.0 comes with breaking changes — you'll need to update your config syntax. Review: Hyprland 0.53.0 Release Notes If you want this tiling WM on Fedora — congrats on good taste :) This is currently the only actively maintained, clean RPM-based option for running Hyprland 0.53 on Fedora without building from source. Feedback or issues are welcome on the GitHub repo. COPR: ashbuk/Hyprland-Fedora
